sitio.descripcion: You and your landlord confirm every payment, month by month. Your rental history is yours, and it comes with you to your next place.

pie.paraArgentina: Inkey is built for rentals in Argentina: amounts are in pesos and adjustments follow Argentine indexes.

landing.titulo: You've paid on time for years.
landing.bajada: You and your landlord confirm every payment, month by month. That history is yours, and it comes with you to your next place.
landing.tengoPropiedad: I have a place to rent out
landing.letraChica: Sign in with your email. No passwords, no credit checks.

ejemplo.mesesTexto: months paid, confirmed by her landlord
ejemplo.cita: Always paid on time, and when the water heater broke she told me right away.

pasos.titulo: Three steps. Ten seconds a month.

uno.texto: They get a link. One tap to confirm, no password to create.

dos.texto: You say you paid. Your landlord marks it received. You both get the receipt.

tres.texto: When you're looking for your next place, you send the link. Revoke it whenever you want.

maquetas.mensaje: Hi Carlos, let's confirm the lease on Inkey so every payment is on the record.
maquetas.aberturas: For the Palermo rental agency · opened 3 times

inquilino.titulo: Show up to every viewing with proof, not promises.
inquilino.punto1: Your confirmed history, ready to send.
inquilino.punto3: Before you sign, see what the landlord is like according to their tenants.

propietario.etiqueta: If you rent out a place
propietario.titulo: Choose a tenant with more than a gut feeling.
propietario.punto1: The candidate's real history, confirmed by other landlords.
propietario.punto2: An automatic receipt every time you confirm a payment.
propietario.punto3: Your reputation as a good landlord, visible to anyone looking.

reglas.titulo: Your history is yours. And nobody gets publicly shamed.

una.texto: Nothing is public. You create each link yourself and revoke it whenever you want.

dos.texto: A month counts when you both confirm it. No blacklists, no black marks.

tres.texto: We don't check banks or credit bureaus. It's your word and your landlord's.

landing.avisoDeBaja: Your account is closed. Thanks for using Inkey.

errores.inesperado: We couldn't save that. Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, send us this code: {ref}
errores.pagoNoSeGuardo: We couldn't save the payment. Try again in a moment.
errores.noSePudo: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

fecha.formato: Use a date in day/month/year format.

monto.mayorACero: The amount has to be more than zero.

alquiler.rol: Choose whether you're adding this as a tenant or as a landlord.
alquiler.direccionCorta: Write the full address, with the street number.
alquiler.barrioCorto: Write the neighbourhood and city. For example: Palermo, CABA.
alquiler.montoFalta: Write how much you pay each month.
alquiler.diaFalta: Choose the day rent is due.
alquiler.indiceLargo: Keep it short: ICL, IPC, fixed…
alquiler.finAntesDeInicio: The end date can't come before the start date.
alquiler.ajusteIncompleto: Fill in both the index and how often it adjusts, or leave both empty.

perfil.celular: Check the phone number: for example +54 9 11 5555 5555.
perfil.intencion: Choose what you want to do first.

validacion.codigo: The code is the numbers that arrived in your email.

mensajePago.alquiler_inactivo: This lease hasn't been confirmed by both sides yet.
mensajePago.periodo_fuera_del_contrato: That month falls outside the lease.
mensajePago.periodo_futuro: You can't report a month that hasn't started yet.
mensajePago.fecha_futura: The payment date can't be in the future.
mensajePago.fecha_muy_vieja: That date is too far before the month you're reporting.
mensajePago.no_sos_el_dueño: Only the landlord can confirm a payment.

mensajeResena.no_esta_terminando: This lease isn't waiting for anyone to confirm it's over.
mensajeResena.lo_propusiste_vos: You're the one who proposed it: the other side has to confirm.
mensajeResena.todavia_no_termino: Reviews are written once the lease ends.
mensajeResena.sin_contraparte: This lease doesn't have the other side confirmed.
mensajeResena.vacia: Pick at least one tag or write something.
mensajeResena.texto_largo: The text can't go over 500 characters.
mensajeResena.etiqueta_invalida: That tag doesn't belong to this review.
mensajeResena.ya_la_dejaste: You already left your review for this lease.

cifra.inquilino: {numero, plural, one {month paid, confirmed by their landlord} other {months paid, confirmed by their landlord}}
cifra.propietario: {numero, plural, one {lease on Inkey} other {leases on Inkey}}

resumen.pagosConfirmados: {cantidad, plural, one {# payment confirmed} other {# payments confirmed}}
resumen.contratosCumplidos: {cantidad, plural, one {# lease completed} other {# leases completed}}

compartir.propietario: {cantidad, plural, one {# lease on Inkey} other {# leases on Inkey}}
compartir.meses: {cantidad, plural, one {# month confirmed} other {# months confirmed}}

confirmadoPorElDueno.detalle: {cantidad, plural, =0 {No months confirmed yet} one {# month confirmed by the other side} other {# months confirmed by the other side}}

tarjetaPerfil.mesesLlenos: Filled months are the ones the other side confirmed.

pdfPerfil.nota: Every confirmed month in this history was reported by the tenant and confirmed by the landlord. Inkey never shows an address, phone number, email or proof of payment, and unconfirmed months don't appear. We don't check banks or credit bureaus.
pdfPerfil.generado: Generated on {fecha} at the request of whoever shared the profile.

ingreso.bajada: Your rental history, always at hand. Sign in with your email or with Google.
ingreso.pistaMail: We'll send you a link to sign in. No passwords.
ingreso.teMandamos: We sent a link and a numeric code to {email}. If it's not there, check your spam folder.
ingreso.campoCodigo: Or type the code from the email
ingreso.pistaCodigo: This always works, even if the link doesn't or you open it on another device.
ingreso.noTeLlego: Didn't get it? Go back and
ingreso.errorGoogle: We couldn't open Google. Try with your email.
ingreso.errorMail: We couldn't send the email. Try again in a moment.
ingreso.errorCodigo: That code isn't right or it expired. Check it or ask for a new one.

rebote.vencido: That link expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
rebote.desactivado: That way of signing in is turned off. Try with Google.
rebote.sinConfirmar: That email still needs to be confirmed. Ask for a new link.
rebote.demasiados: You asked for several links in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
rebote.incompleto: That link is incomplete. Ask for a new one.
rebote.servidor: Something broke on our side. Ask for a new link.
rebote.generico: That link no longer works: it expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.

onboarding.errorGuardar: We couldn't save your details. Try again in a moment.
onboarding.bajada: It takes two minutes. Your full name is only visible to the person you share a lease with: your public profile shows your first name and the initial of your last name.
onboarding.pistaCelular: We use it to reach you on WhatsApp. It never appears on your public profile.
onboarding.quePrimero: What would you like to do first?
onboarding.soloParaEmpezar: It's just so we know where to start: you can do both later.
onboarding.opcionInquilinoDetalle: I rent, and I want to build my history.
onboarding.opcionPropietarioTitulo: Add a place I rent out
onboarding.opcionPropietarioDetalle: I have a place I rent out.
onboarding.leiPrivacidad: I've read the <link>privacy policy</link> and I accept the processing of my data.

panel.bajada: Here's what needs your attention first.
panel.nadaPendiente: Nothing pending right now. When there's a payment to report or confirm, it shows up here at the top.
panel.yaPagaste: Did you pay <capital>{mes}</capital> at <fuerte>{lugar}</fuerte>? Report it so your landlord can confirm.
panel.noRecibio: Your landlord hasn't received the <capital>{mes}</capital> payment at <fuerte>{lugar}</fuerte> yet.
panel.teMarcaronFin: Someone marked the lease at <fuerte>{lugar}</fuerte> as over. Confirm if that's right.
panel.terminoTuAlquiler: Your lease at <fuerte>{lugar}</fuerte> ended. Tell them how it went: the other side won't see your review until they leave theirs.
panel.esperandoDueno: <fuerte>{lugar}</fuerte> is waiting for your landlord to confirm.
panel.esperandoInquilino: <fuerte>{lugar}</fuerte> is waiting for your tenant to confirm.
panel.rechazado: At <fuerte>{lugar}</fuerte> they said the place isn't theirs. Check who you sent the link to.
panel.vacioInquilinoTitulo: You haven't added your lease yet
panel.vacioInquilinoTexto: Add the details, invite your landlord, and from the first confirmed month you start building your history.
panel.vacioPropietarioTitulo: You haven't added a place yet
panel.vacioPropietarioTexto: Add the place, invite your tenant, and confirm each payment in two taps from your phone.
